citations.field: 好 headword, formation and meaning discussion; printed p. 1094 / PDF p. 1109
citations.text: The scan shows the actual 好 entry. It identifies oracle-bone, bronze, Warring States and Shuowen seal forms as 女 plus 子, and the author calls its original meaning ‘woman’, then describes extension to beauty/goodness and a verbal ‘like/love’ sense. The page cites Shang personal name 婦好 and 《合集》6412. This is the book author’s account, not independent proof of the proposed original sense or a complete semantic chronology. I visually checked the word introducing the bronze example: the scan reads 虘鐘, not the provisional OCR 虐钟. Proposed source-bound OCR correction only; no corpus correction made.
